page.layout: One printed page: running head "EMBLEMA" centred above the title; a title in two lines at full width; a woodcut emblem picture in the centre; a verse motto of four lines centred below the picture; the catchword "Talia" at the right below the verse.

main_text.head: DOLVS AN VIRTVS QVIS IN hoste requirat.
main_text.p: [Woodcut: an emblem picture of a mounted warrior in a fanciful helmet with plumes, a stork beside him, a horse, and a row of soldiers below; described under notes.]
main_text.l: Fraudes atq; dolos nemo laudauerit vnquam,
Ni sint contra hostem bella gerenda suum:
Nilq; refert seu virtute aut strategemate vincas,
Dum referas herbam res bene gesta tibi est.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a rider in plumed helmet on a rearing horse, with a stork at left and a row of soldiers beneath; no printed text inside the picture. The title line reads "DOLVS AN VIRTVS QVIS IN" with "hoste requirat." on the second line; the first word of the title is set as a large initial D. The verse lines are in italic type with a long s rendered as a plain s.
